items.title: টেসলা-মার্সিডিজ গাড়ির চেয়েও মাল্টায় শুল্ক-কর বেশি
items.description: মাল্টা আমদানিতে শুল্ক–করভার ১২১ দশমিক ৭৮ শতাংশ। অথচ টেসলায় ৮০ শতাংশ এবং প্লাগ-ইন হাইব্রিড মার্সিডিজে ৯৬ দশমিক ১০ শতাংশ শুল্ক–কর।

items.title: Akij Resource acquires 30% stake in Dominage Steel
items.description: Dominage Steel Building Systems disclosed yesterday that its board had recorded the transfer of 3.07 crore shares, about 30 percent of its 10 crore, to Akij Resource and two of its top executives, and approved a new board.

items.title: Banks cut CSR spending by 80% in five years
items.description: Banks have sharply cut spending on corporate social responsibility (CSR) as financial difficulties have reduced the capacity of many lenders to contribute, while some have been simply unable to make any contribution amid losses.

items.title: MGH Group Chairman Ghaziul Haque passes away
items.description: M Ghaziul Haque, chairman of MGH Group and founding director and former chairman of Eastern Bank (EBL), died at Evercare Hospital in Dhaka yesterday. He was 92.

items.title: ‘Financial reporting must ensure investor confidence’
items.description: Financial reporting, auditing and corporate governance must ensure transparency and integrity to build foreign investors’ confidence in Bangladesh, the prime minister’s special assistant for investment and capital market affairs said yester

items.title: Govt seeks to advance FTA talks with Türkiye
items.description: Bangladesh wants to advance negotiations on a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with Türkiye and strengthen trade and investment ties between the two countries, Commerce Minister Khandakar Abdul Muktadir said yesterday.

items.title: BTRC plans to relaunch NEIR on January 1
items.description: The Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (BTRC) has decided to relaunch the National Equipment Identity Register (NEIR) on January 1, 2027, with a feature to block illegal handsets brought into the country after the launch.
